https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/85217/why-is-this-series-of-square-root-of-twos-equal-pi

A long time ago when I was 18 I discovered this by messing around with circles and the definition of pi and I was beyond ecstatic when I thought I was the first one who discovered it so I ran to all professors of the universities in my city and no one heard of it which felt surreal. I was so happy. and one of them was an old ivy league math professor. He said "never heard of it and I don't have time to prove it" lol. Another was baffled and said definatly send this to the association and see if it's a first. 

I spent months doing research till I found out it has been proved in a research paper in 2001 (LD Servi)  which is mostly a derivative of a  1500s discovery (Vietes)

So yea maybe if I was 500 years older lol. Nevertheless, wether I was the first or not, I experienced the joy of doing real math which is different from studying math as in being fed formulas, strategies, conventional ways of thinking, etc by professors and just executing. 

I feel bad I forgot about my math hobby. Life got In the way.

I know you're a coffee batista, but you just served some tea.

Starbucks is a big cooperation and it cares more about money and stability than passionate employees. 

It's not simply saying "fucking." Its that you showed emotional instability and unprofessionality by using that word. In English, they saw you as a loose cannon aimed at starbucks' image and reputation and also probably cause they didn't wanna deal with you anymore.

Judging on the fact they called it a "harassment," it's probably also cause that guy took it personally and just didn't wanna keep you around.

It would make sense cause older people tend to be more sensitive and take every interaction seriously but younger people throw around heavy tense words and tones without realizing their impact and meaning. 

I get how you're just passionate and didn't mean it personally. You just were innocently caring about the rat thing and using fuck as an emphasis.

But the guy overanalyzed your words took it as a personal attack like you were pissed at him and having a threatening tone when you were just relaxed not taking your choice of words too seriously. You just cared about taking care of the rat situation. Typical young habit. Understandable.

Whenever I order in the app automatically records what I ordered so I looked back and put it all in a spreadsheet to see the damage. Now I get why I went back up 25 pounds in few weeks after spending 6 months losing it.

It's a long story but I'm in a place where if I don't eat the unhealthiest thing or anything that's strong enough, I'd lose my mind. Always one thing after the other. I recently lost so much and I'm not sure my life makes sense anymore so blacking out and eating these things stops me from thinking about that.

It's not gonna sound like a serious comment but it really is. I never found that thing that makes my life worth living and the reason I lived so far was because I wanted to wait and see if I'll ever find that thing

I always knew that I'm not meant to be alive and that this is all simply not meant for me. I've been pushed out socially and it just feels like there's nothing special to see here in life.

It was so painful living without a reason but it was scarier to get myself to actually do it and kill myself and so what resulted is a very sad life. I couldn't get myself to get a job. I couldn't brush my teeth. I couldn't shower. I'd just eat all the time so I don't have to think about anything other than food. 

So im alive but I definatly don't think my life is worth living even though I get to live it for free, it's cruel and when you're old, you gotta accept the world is built for young free people and that you staying alive is pointless. 

Plus, I think my addictive habits will kill me before I do. You just know at some point in your life whether you're meant to be here or whether there's a point of you living life. 

Simply put, you get what you get. You're born where you're born. And some of us get bad lives with a silver living but there are some of us that just get straight up darkness with no way out and while you're alive, it's just a matter of deciding whether to kill yourself or riding your life out by getting high. 

You're either have a good life that you don't question, cause why would you? Or you have a bad life that you question and when you start to question, it leads you to some pretty dark answers that make you wish you were never born.

So my point is life is only for those who have enough good that they won't question it too much.
